description.en: A whole-animal reconstruction of Homoioptera, with broad overlapping wings, small thoracic winglets and exceptionally long paired cerci. It combines same-species evidence; body depth, missing extremities and colour are interpretive.
description.zh: Homoioptera的完整活体复原，具有宽阔重叠的翅、小型前胸翼片与极长双尾须。综合同种证据制作，体厚、缺失末端和颜色为解释性补全。

anatomy: Four broad subtriangular flight wings, fore/hind pairs considerably overlapping but separated vertically enough to read in views; widest proximal/middle and taper to rounded-pointed outer margins. No narrow Stenodictya-like wings.
Two small prothoracic lobes spread laterally ahead of flight wings, lightly pointed outward with fan-like venation. Not third full-sized flight wings.
Head with paired conspicuous compound eyes, long slender antennae, long central sucking beak and long leg-like maxillary palps. Palps are NOT a fourth walking-leg pair.
Three thoracic walking-leg pairs; articulated femur/tibia/tarsi, relatively short against large wings. Preserve distinct head appendage origins to separate palps from feet.
Segmented tapering abdomen with two extremely long articulated cerci, substantially longer than body and exceeding wingspan along arc. Use gentle divergence/curve without tangling silhouette.

Wing membranes lack observed color spots in this species, according2010. Subtle longitudinal veins and simplified branching/crossvein net; do not borrow woodwardi circular spots or gigantic gigantea size.
restoration_boundaries: Fig2D is actual fossil photograph; E interpreted tracing with damaged cerci and3cmbar; F head detail with0.5cmbar. All viewed, not generatedconcept.
Brauckmann1988drawing reproducedon1989p63 supplies complete posture and appendage arrangement, but old25cmtotalcaption is not used to override later>20cmcercus finding.

2010 same researchers describe five nearlycomplete specimens, long beak/palps/antennae, laterallyspread winglets, overlapping unspotted wings and extreme venational variability. Exact vein count is not artificially fixed asspeciesdiagnosis.
Selected restoration is same-species synthesis; no woodwardi body from onlywing specimen, no gigantea scale, no uncertain museumID claims.
Terminal sex-specific structures omitted rather than combining femaleovipositor with maleclaspers; individual sex not asserted. Longpairedcerci remain.
Depth, living posture, missingdistalextremities and color areinterpretive. No reconstructedairbreathingorgans shown externally.

scale.uncertainty: Body from sameFigure2E3cmbar; species wingspanapprox200mm. Cerci reported>200mm on one specimen; chosen220mm final taper interpretive, not exact preserved endpoint.1989caption total25cm is older reconstruction, not definitive adult total.

scientific_limits.en: Same-species interpretive reconstruction, not one perfectly preserved individual. 2010 authors report five near-complete specimens, wingspan about200mm and one incomplete cercus exceeding200mm. Body85mm and subdivisions estimated fromFig2E3cmbar;220mm cerci are conservative interpretation, not measured complete length. Figure2 specimen catalog number is unverified; do not assert a holotype or assign WMf.N.P.27205 without further evidence.
scientific_limits.zh: 同种解释复原，非单一完整保存个体。2010原研究者报告五个近完整标本、翼展约200毫米及一根未完整尾须保存超过200毫米。体长85毫米按图2E三厘米尺估计，尾须220毫米是保守补全而非完整实测。图2馆号未核实，不冒称模式或强行绑定WMf.N.P.27205。

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Complete Carboniferous Homoioptera with broad subtriangular overlapping flight wings and small paired prothoracic winglets, long antennae, sucking beak, conspicuous palps and extremely long paired cerci. Anchored to real same-species fossil Fig2D–F in Brauckmann etal2010 and the original researcher whole-animal drawing published1989.
